issues.description: Worst-case coating modifier stack (QT4 + scaffold + split_face_cmu + rough + elastomeric = 5.62x) exceeds 4.0x cap. This represents an extreme theoretical scenario: QT4 elastomeric on rough split-face CMU at scaffold height.
issues.suggested_fix: Document T&M billing recommendation for this specific combination. The scenario is rare (elastomeric on split-face CMU at scaffold is uncommon in residential) but theoretically possible. Flag in spec.json variants.
issues.notes: Same pattern as NC spec where max stack was 3.744x. RP adds condition dimension to prep pool and coating_system to coating pool, increasing theoretical maximums.

issues.description: PS_EXT_META.ENUM.CONDITION_SCALE and PS_EXT_META.ENUM.MASONRY_TEXTURE are proposed new PaintScope keys. These should be standardized across all exterior RP specs using condition scale and masonry texture.
issues.suggested_fix: Add to id_registry.json as shared exterior RP keys. Condition scale is already used implicitly in SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_RP and SF_TRIM_EXT_RP (as condition_scale dimension). Masonry texture is masonry-specific but follows the same pattern.
issues.notes: Registry additions are documented in resolution.json registry_additions_proposed. Will be formalized during registry update.
